Via Amsterdam is more than just a youth hotel- it's a vibrant, multi-functional playground for curious, new-age travellers. And at the heart of it all? The reception. As our Night Receptionist , you're not just a team member - you're the soul of the night shift .

Being the first smiling face guests see (even at 2 AM!)). 
 - 
Checking guests in and out, answering calls, and helping with questions. 
 - 
Giving the lowdown on Amsterdam's must-sees, hidden gems, and can't-miss experiences. 
 - 
Doing security rounds, handling issues, and making detailed reports. 
 - 
Keeping tabs on stock and restocking as needed. 
 - 
Wrapping up front office admin tasks like the night audit. 
 - 
Keeping the lobby looking sharp and welcoming. 
You'll be a great fit if you bring a few of the below with you:

Strong hospitality and communication skills - English is a must, and bonus points if you speak another language too!

As a Service & Support Engineer at Accelonix, you work with high-quality, complex machines in the electronics industry. In this varied role, technology, troubleshooting, and customer contact are central. 
Your responsibilities: - Installation & Maintenance: Installing and maintaining machines at customers in the Netherlands and Belgium; - Troubleshooting: Analyzing and resolving technical problems, both on-site and remotely; - Support & Advice: Advising, supporting, and training customers in the use of software and systems; - International Cooperation: Solving technical issues together with foreign machine manufacturers; - In-house Work: Testing electronic printed circuit boards and assembling microelectronics in Eindhoven; - Innovate: Actively contribute ideas for technical improvements for the customer. 
We offer: - Challenge & Technology: An independent technical role where you work with high-quality machines from leading manufacturers; - Flexible workplace: A great combination of work on location at clients and from our office in Eindhoven; - Team & Atmosphere: A collegial and informal working atmosphere within a close-knit technical team; - Growth & Development: An extensive onboarding program with good guidance and opportunities to develop yourself through international training; - Employment conditions: A competitive salary, laptop, phone, and, upon proven suitability, immediate prospect of permanent employment. 
Your profile: - Education & Foundation: Technical background (electrical engineering, electronics or mechatronics); - Basic knowledge of PC/software and possession of a B driving license; - Characteristics: You work accurately, analytically, practically, and are eager to learn; - Good communication in Dutch/English is required; - Pros: Experience with electronics, assembly, measuring equipment, or PCBs is a plus.
